title: Book Three · Chapter 77: The Same Window
story:
On Monday, Kai looks from Ronan to the classroom window.

“It hasn't moved,” he says.

Ronan turns. “What?”

“The window. You keep smiling at it.”

Ronan looks down at his book. Anna is beside him, taking out her pencil.

Kai studies both faces. Then he grins and returns to his own desk.

For the first lesson, Ronan keeps his eyes on the board. He copies one line, checks it, and copies the next.

Anna's hand rests near the edge of her page. He notices it without looking away from the lesson for long.

At lunch, Lin comes to ask Anna about a maths question. The girls move two chairs together near the window.

Ronan closes his lunch box. For a moment, he wants Anna to come outside with him.

She looks up.

“We need to finish this first.”

“All right.”

Kai is already at the door with the ball. Ronan takes his bottle and goes with him.

On the grass, his first pass goes too high. Kai catches it against his chest.

“Still smiling?”

“Still catching badly?”

Kai laughs and throws it back.

They play with two other boys. Ronan has to watch the ball now. He stops one fast pass with both hands and sends it across before Kai can turn.

“Better,” Kai says.

“The window helped.”

At the bell, they collect the bottles. Anna and Lin come out of the building for a little air before the next lesson.

“Finished?” Ronan asks.

Anna nods. “One question. Not the whole book.”

Lin laughs and goes ahead to her classroom. Anna waits beside the steps.

Kai looks at them, then lifts his hand toward his friend on the other side of the yard.

“I'll see you upstairs.”

For a few steps, Ronan and Anna walk alone. Their hands touch once beside the stair rail. Anna looks at him, and he smiles again.

“Kai knows,” she says.

“The window told him.”

She laughs quietly. Then the stairs fill with other students, and they go back to the classroom.

After school, Anna needs to return a library book with Lin. Ronan has promised Dad to buy bread on the way home.

At the gate, he gives Anna's hand a small squeeze and lets go.

“Tomorrow,” she says.

“Tomorrow.”

He walks past the library road and takes the turn toward the bread shop. The warm smell reaches him before the door.

He buys the bread and carries it home. Dad is still at work today. Mum looks at the bag, then at his face.

“Good day?”

Ronan smiles. “Yes.”
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

stair rail＝楼梯扶手；squeeze＝轻握；smile at＝对着……笑；copy＝抄写。

## 理解问题

1. Kai怎样察觉Ronan这天有些不同？
2. Anna忙数学和还书时，Ronan分别做了什么？他有没有放弃自己的朋友和家中约定？

## 读句子

**He buys the bread and carries it home.**

拆开看：He / buys the bread / and carries it home.

他／买好面包／把它带回家。
